# BTicino C300X Integration v1.7.6

## Fixed

- Stabilize WebRTC media shutdown so stopping an on-demand view or ring-call
  session closes Home Assistant/go2rtc clients before the C300X media session is
  stopped.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload all open Home Assistant browser dashboards after updating so the
  bundled frontend modules are refreshed from the installed integration
  version.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.7.6`.
